[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9142541), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3372009762), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/CloseSneak), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000055934), [Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/9221), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=w8r7), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/close_and_secretive), [Toomics](https://toomics.com/click/intro?cno=9193&pid=conist) 

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0002902), Spanish 

On that day, I was going to confess to you.


Choi Ji-young, an unidentified woman who accidentally encountered her on Ulleungdo Island.  
Sunwoo Hyun keeps bothering Ji-young.  
Two people who are attracted to each other even in a short period of time.  
Then one day, Ji-young suddenly disappears.  
Without a trace.


"It's been a while, Hyun. Aren't you going to say hello?"

Ji-young, who could not be found no matter how much she visited, became the "Choi Ji-an" and appeared in four years.  
That's also for Hyun to protect.

"With this time, there is no Choi Ji-young I knew. So, just delete it too."
